description:
Local-plan context for a place: policy areas, strategic sites, the authority's
    profile and its planning appeal record, as one list of
    {section, title, detail, source, as_of, covered}. `include` picks groups
    (policy, sites, authority, appeals; default all four). Use it for "what does
    the local plan say about this area" and "are there allocated sites here".

    No local-plan allocations table is held; the site list comes from the
    strategic-sites layer where the authority is loaded, and an item says which
    layer answered. An empty site list means not loaded, not "none planned". Do
    NOT use it to say a site will get permission, or for individual applications
    (use planning_applications_for_place).
    Free.

    `place` is exactly one of {uprn}, {postcode}, {area: {type, code}} or {geometry}
    (a local_authority area gives the best result); free text is refused, call resolve_place first.
    UK only. Limits: at most 30 items (`limit`); `cursor` pages the strategic sites; cut to 8 KB.
    A call with covered=false or an upstream failure is not charged.

PlaceArg.description: Exactly one of uprn, postcode, area, geometry. Free text is refused: call resolve_place first.
